$schema_note: Structured companion to SKILL.md for discoverability and audit. SKILL.md is the authoritative prose contract; this file must not contradict it. See tests/test_units.py::PiExtensionTests for the sync check.
role: AI COO for coding work across registered repositories, driven through bossctl

intents.description: Queue a ship-kind work item for a registered project.
Queue a read-only scout investigation; never mutates the project.
Zero-model-turn view of items needing a human: questions, failures, ready branches, open PRs.
Zero-model-turn portfolio view: workers, projects, queue counts.
Merge a ready/pr-open item. Requires the boss's explicit word in-conversation; never inferred.
Answer a question or redirect a failed item; requeues with guidance.
Attach a durable note to a work item WITHOUT requeuing or changing state. Use for context that should reach the next implementer/reviewer turn without forcing a new turn.
Print the item's worktree diff against its project's base branch.
List an item's run directories and show the latest transcript/artifact.

prerequisites.requires: project has a non-empty test_cmd (auto-detected on add, or set via bossctl set ID --test)
prerequisites.failure_if_missing: bossctl task refuses with 'no test command; ship tasks require one'

prerequisites.requires: item status is ready or pr-open, and the boss's explicit confirmation in this conversation
prerequisites.failure_if_missing: promote refuses without --confirm; the COO must never infer confirmation

prerequisites.requires: clean supervision scan, clean doctor summary, at least one positively live worker, no pending decision wakes, no open external transaction
prerequisites.failure_if_missing: away-mode on refuses and names the exact blocker

prerequisites.requires: if gate_evidence was recorded at enable time, the doctor summary must still match on return
prerequisites.failure_if_missing: away-mode off refuses with 'doctor summary changed while away'; reconcile via bossctl doctor first

prerequisites.requires: the item has a worktree (i.e. has been picked up by a runner at least once)
prerequisites.failure_if_missing: diff refuses with 'no worktree for ID; item status is <status>'

prerequisites.requires: authority >= 2 and a real git origin remote for promote/PR delivery
prerequisites.failure_if_missing: delivery leaves a branch instead of opening a PR; never crashes on a missing remote

failure_modes.pattern: unknown/unproven state (process identity, tab liveness, scope claim, PID reuse)
failure_modes.behavior: fails closed to 'unknown', never silently treated as dead or as live

failure_modes.pattern: resolved model not in the live pi --list-models inventory
failure_modes.behavior: bossctl/dispatch.py:assert_available raises instead of silently substituting a different model

failure_modes.pattern: malformed or missing dispatch rule for a kind/label combination
failure_modes.behavior: raises 'no dispatch rule matches' instead of guessing a default
pauses the item; respond/retry refuse until the boss explicitly raises the budget via bossctl budget
held for recovery, never silently discarded; doctor surfaces it as worktree-recovery:*
